displayTitle: Star Destroyer Book and 3D Wood Model
synopsis: Star Wars: Star Destroyer Book and 3D Wood Model is an Imperial-class Star Destroyer model kit published by Insight Editions as part of their IncrediBuilds collection. The kit includes a laser-cut, FSC-certified wood sheet, step-by-step instructions, coloring and crafting ideas, and a Star Destroyer booklet.
title: Star Destroyer Book and 3D Wood Model
